triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:devx` (ui scripts vitest) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:fleet (a test; it had no area) · Bug · `date-only-zone-pins-10183` fails after another test writes `process.env.TZ` without restoring it, an order-dependent red → p2 as filed · size XS.

repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAjMMU8pcMXmiLEMMG4

Premise reading · 2026-11-24T16:01Z · area f2-E (seat 2), pre-claim, on `origin/main` a73edb3c. Verdict: **does not reproduce**, and the cause sentence does not match the code. No claim was made.

Runs (from `ui/`, canonical `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit …`, deps installed, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/formula` built):
- `date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` alone: 30 passed, 0 failed (the file has 30 cases on this tree, not 39).
- `vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts` then the 10183 file in one invocation: 34/34 passed; the same pair with `--sequence.shuffle`, seeds 1 and 2: 34/34 each.
- The whole `scripts` directory (174 files) with `--sequence.shuffle`, seeds 101, 202, 303: neither the 10183 file nor the 8366 file failed in any run. The 8–11 failures per run were in four unrelated files (`check-doc-snippet-types`, `spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265`, `unit-registry-absence-collision`, and on two seeds `plan-test-ui-shards` with an ENOENT on its own tmp `sel.json`), consistent with the partial build used for the reading; not read further here.

Why the stated mechanism cannot hold on this tree:
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts` never writes `process.env.TZ` in-process; it passes `TZ` only in a spawned child's env.
- Every in-process `process.env.TZ = …` write in ui test files sits under `describe.runIf(process.env.OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD === '1')`, i.e. only inside the forked child the 10183 driver spawns; the child loads `ui/vitest.config.mts`, which re-pins `process.env.TZ = 'UTC'` at module scope. The only ungated write is that config line.
- `ui/scripts/**` is not its own vitest project; it is part of `unit` (`isolate: false`) with `packages/**`, and several pin files run in the `dom` project inside the child.

Open: why the filer's run failed 2 cases. Shapes seen here that produce failures of the 10183 file without any TZ leak: a stale or partial build (before building spec and formula the file failed 27 of 30 with `Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec/ui'`), or load against the child's spawn timeout. Inside the child, five pin files write TZ with no restoring `afterEach` (`AdvancedChartImpl.dateOnlyZone-10866`, `TimelineRenderer.dateOnlyZone-10866`, `scheduling.dateOnlyZone-10866`, `formatValue.dateOnlyZone-10844`, `timesheet.dateTimeZone-34382`); an intra-child leak from them is not demonstrated.

Routing goes to the seat; this comment changes no state.

triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Closing as not planned: it cannot be reproduced on current main, and the stated cause does not exist in the code. This answers repo:objectstack#2's question (mailbox #36743, 7137097055), on its premise reading 7137005637, on `origin/main` a73edb3c:
- The 10183 file passes alone and after the 8366 file, including shuffled, across three whole-directory shuffles.
- `vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts` never writes `process.env.TZ` in-process.
- Every in-process write is gated to the forked child, which re-pins `TZ = 'UTC'`.

The unrelated failures that reading saw under a partial build (`check-doc-snippet-types`, `spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265`, `unit-registry-absence-collision`, `plan-test-ui-shards`) are not this card. If any of them reproduces on a full build, it gets its own card. Reopen this card if the 10183 file fails again in an order-dependent way, with the run's file order.
